==Trivia==
*The game features the first voiced female protagonist of the series (previous female protagonists were depicted as silent criminals).
*The game adapted two historical figures and at least [[Duke Arms Company|one company]] from the {{Red Dead|Red Dead Universes|Redemption Universe}} of the ''[[Red Dead]]'' series into the HD Universe of the ''Grand Theft Auto'' series, presumably as a result of the collaboration with [[Rockstar San Diego]] during the game's development.
*The game appears to be the first numbered title since ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]'' to use the "subtitle version" of ''GTA''{{'}}s [[Fonts|Pricedown logo]].
*Following Rockstar Games' confirmation of the release date for the upcoming ''GTA''{{'}}s first trailer, a number of game studios posted dummy trailer/update announcements on {{WP|Twitter|X}} with almost identical styles, color schemes and release dates to that of the upcoming ''GTA'' title's announcement. These included {{WP|Mediatonic}}'s ''{{WP|Fall Guys}}''{{Ref|name = fall-guys|type = twitter|date = 12/01/2023|url = https://twitter.com/fallguysgame/status/1730643986258227592|ref = Fall Guys on X, December 1, 2023|image = FallGuys-Dec2023-TrailerAnnouncement-X.png|caption = Fall Guys announcement image from December 1, 2023.}}, {{WP|343 Industries}}' ''{{WP|Halo (franchise)|Halo}}''{{Ref|name = halo|type = twitter|date = 12/01/2023|url = https://twitter.com/Halo/status/1730684560730436095|ref = 343 Industries on X, December 1, 2023|image = HaloInfinite-Dec2023-TrailerAnnouncement-X.jpg|caption = Halo announcement image from December 1, 2023.}}, and {{WP|Raven Software}}'s ''{{WP|Call of Duty}}''.{{Ref|name = call-of-duty|type = twitter|date = 12/01/2023|url = https://twitter.com/RavenSoftware/status/1730741119871311958|ref = RavenSoftware on X, December 1, 2023}}
*The reveal of State of Leonida in the first trailer {{WP|Retroactive continuity|retcons}} the few mentions to [[State of Florida|Florida]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto IV]]'' by [[Niko Bellic]], [[Hossan Ramzy]], and [[Weazel News]]. However, the game appears to be faithfully following the HD Universe's Vice City lore established since ''[[Grand Theft Auto IV]]'', in terms of geographical characteristics and ethnic makeup.
**The first trailer also implies that [[Grove Street Games]] used assets from ''Grand Theft Auto VI'' during the development of ''[[Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition]]'' in 2021 (e.g. [[Daewang]] logo).
**Further textures were later included in [[Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition/Title Update Notes/Update-2024-11-12|Title Update 1.112]] by [[Video Games Deluxe]] in an attempt to replace/fix previous AI upscaled textures, including a texture asset originally used for [[Uncle Jack's Liquor]] in ''Grand Theft Auto VI'', visible in the final shot of the first trailer.{{fact|Can't find the texture.}}
*Ahead of the game's release date on November 19, 2026, BambooHR reported that there was an increase of 9-17% of vacation requests on the launch date compared to a normal third Thursday of November.<ref name="GTA6Vacation">[https://money.com/gta-6-vacation-requests/ GTA 6 Is Already Causing Workers to Request Vacation Time - Money]</ref>
**Reports suggest that the ''Grand Theft Auto VI'' release could cost $1 billion in US output in one day due to Americans taking sick days, with a suggested 1.5 million people skipping work.<ref name="GTASickDay">[https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/gta-6-launch-billion-dollar-sick-day-1818190 GTA 6 Launch Could Trigger a Billion-Dollar 'Sick Day' - International Business Times UK]</ref>
